newsitem.title: UK: MSAS opens new logistics centre in Japan.
newsitem.headline: MSAS opens new logistics centre in Japan.

text.p: MSAS Tokyo, part of international freight forwarders MSAS Cargo International has opened a new logistics centres in Nishifunabashi, close to the Tokyo Air Cargo Terminal (TACT), midway between Narita airport and central Tokyo.

The two storey building covers 1192 sq metres and will provide logistics services involving maintaining import or export inventories, as well as domestic or international distribution, the company said in a statement.

Atsushi Fujita, manager, said "Our aim is to build a highly efficient, low-cost, logistics operation. We have very ambitious growth plans for 1997 and this is an important part of gearing-up to meet the challenge of additional tonnage and shipments moving through the Tokyo gateway." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
